findings: All twelve geometry views inspected before SVG acceptance. Farfalle consists of two independent continuous thickened rectangular pasta sheets with fluted ends and a pinched center; no separate bow band or filling. Approximate five-centimeter length and 1.2-millimeter sheet thickness are illustrative.

Pizza lies inside a handleless round pan with a closed base. Pan diameter approximately 22.6 cm and height 4.1 cm; dough and toppings are supported inside. No exact recipe dimensions claimed. Organizer photographs of both foods were personally inspected, not traced.

Projected contours preserve connected pasta folds and pan occlusion. Restrained broad paint regions fit accepted pasta/pizza peers. Minor pan shading seams and pasta folds soften at 16 px without breaking silhouettes.
Five native cards, nine accepted/Noto references and all ten actual IconManager variants inspected on light/dark. No clipping, unsupported intersections or material spacing defects observed.
The other three are original flat pictograms with symbolic notation; no human figure or physical device assembly is claimed.
